claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic memory evolution/degradation primitive for Frankenstein 2.0. It must preserve the exact caller-supplied memory payload reference/digest and provenance while allowing only explicit lifecycle transitions such as ACTIVE -> DEGRADED, DEGRADED -> ACTIVE, and ACTIVE|DEGRADED -> SUPERSEDED with an explicit successor reference. It must have no destructive DELETE transition, no clock-driven decay, no retrieval ranking, no semantic/factual inference, no UnifiedDB reads/writes, no provider/model/tool calls, no effect authority and no completion authority. Every mutation must be fenced by exact memory_id, generation and prior-state digest. Source plus deterministic falsification tests and repository-hosted CI only; no VPS, physical GRID10 or whole-system credit.
